preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 400,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertex indices in the edges must be within the range from 1 to n.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1 for a valid tree.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(x in {'0', '1'} for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output must be either 0 or 1.
At least one vertex must be marked as a centroid (1) in the output.
